div.head: Had 7
div.ab: And to hadbote, gif fulbrice wurðe, toeacan þam rihtwere, æt þam VI. stæpe VI pund to bote, mid godcundan scrifte.
⁊ to hadbote, gif fullbrice wurðe, toeacan þam rihtwere, æt þam sixtan stæpe VI pund to bóte, mid godcundre scrifte.
⁊ to hadbote, gif fullbryce wurðe, toeacan þam rihtwere, æt þam syxtan stæpe VI pund to bote, mid godcundan scrifte.
In sexto gradu, si ordinis infractio fiat (infracto gradu), supra rectam weram, emendet sex libris (VI librę emendentur) cum (digna) penitentia.
And to hadbote, gif fullbryce wurðe, toeacan þam rihtwere æt þam syxtan stæpe VI pund to bote, mid godcundan scrifte.
Und wenn tödtliche Verletzung eintritt: ausser dem gesetzlichen Wergeld beim sechsten Ordo als Klerusbusse 6 Pfund zur Busse, neben geistlicher Poenitenz.
And if fatal injury occurs: besides the lawful wergild, for the sixth grade 6 pounds as compensation for orders, with spiritual penance.

And as compensation for one in orders if a full breach of the peace occurs, the perpetrator must make amends for the sixth rank by paying six pounds as a penalty in addition to the standard wergild and by doing spiritual penance.

And in compensation for [an offence against a man in] orders, if a full breach occurs, one must pay for the sixth degree with six pounds in addition to the legal wergild, and intercede zealously with ecclesiastical penance.
div.note: U: not in Whitelock’s English Historical Documents, which prints only Had 1–2 and 9–11 (with “…” for the rest); the source of this translation is not recorded.
